a: SVD factors A = UΣVᵀ with orthogonal U,V and singular values in Σ.
PCA finds orthogonal directions of maximum variance, often via SVD/eigenvectors.
Vectors are orthogonal if their dot product is zero.
An orthonormal basis has unit orthogonal vectors spanning the space.
Null space is all x with Ax = 0.
Column space is the span of A's columns (range of the linear map).
A symmetric matrix is positive definite if xᵀAx > 0 for all nonzero x.
Condition number measures sensitivity of solutions to input perturbations.
Least squares minimizes ||Ax - b||₂, solved via normal equations or QR/SVD.
